app_fee.value: Application fee is $25 for Fall, Spring, and Summer admission ($10 additional late fee if submitted after the published deadline).
app_fee.quote: The Graduate School Admissions Application Deadlines SEMESTER/TERM APPLICATION FEE DEADLINE LATE FEE Fall $25.00 April 15 $10.00

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are limited to U.S. veterans per Louisiana Board of Regents policy (with proof of current military service or DD214); no general or international fee waiver is stated.
fee_waiver.quote: The SUBR Application Fee is waived for all U.S. veterans, per Louisiana's Board of Regents, the governing body for all institutions of Higher Education in the state. Proof of current military service or a DD214 military separation form is required to provide this waiver.

gre_general.value: Acceptable scores on the GRE General Test are required for admission to doctoral programs.
gre_general.quote: Submit acceptable scores in the General Test of the Graduate Record Examination

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score of 77 (525 paper-based) for international applicants in the 2024-2026 Graduate Catalog.
toefl_min.quote: For international students, a minimum score of 525 (computer based) or 77 (Internet based) on the Test of English as a Foreign language (TOEFL) as evidence of proficiency in English

ielts_min.value: IELTS is accepted by the Graduate School alongside TOEFL, but no numeric minimum IELTS band score is stated in the 2024-2026 Graduate Catalog.

english_waiver.value: The 2024-2026 Graduate Catalog requires TOEFL or IELTS for applicants whose native language is not English with no explicit waiver listed for India, while the Program Requirements page states TOEFL is required for applicants in countries where the medium of instruction is not English; contact the Graduate School to confirm whether an Indian degree qualifies.

notes: Baton Rouge campus (subr.edu). Out of 6 doctoral programs in the 2024-2026 Graduate Catalog, 2 are Atlas STEM PhDs: Urban Forestry (environment) and Environmental Toxicology (biomed, also environment). Other doctorates are Science/Mathematics Education (PhD/SMED, STEM pedagogy/curriculum rather than discipline research), Nursing (PhD/DNP), and Public Policy (PhD). Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics/Physics, and Engineering are Master's-only.
